slides.name: cover
slides.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Generate ONE new 16:9 landscape image, a premium photorealistic background plate for the LUNARIS educational lunar-base game presentation by Parsec Studio. Senior editorial game-art direction and meticulous Photoshop compositing: matte black/graphite, ivory lunar geology, restrained amber cabin lights, very subtle cyan equipment lights. Serious believable engineering, tactile metal, insulation, seams, dry angular regolith, harsh low-angle sunlight, physically correct contact shadows, black vacuum sky without atmospheric fog, tiny realistic Earth where appropriate. Fictional future outpost concept, never documentary NASA footage. No people, no human astronaut, no NASA logos or agency insignia. This is a presentation background to be typeset later: absolutely NO WORDS, LETTERS, NUMBERS, captions, diagrams, interface mockups, logos, watermarks, frames or borders. Main copy area must remain genuinely dark and uncluttered. No glossy toy models, neon holograms, wet rocks, artificial bloom or stock-template gradients. Exquisite natural texture, cinematic controlled exposure, calm asymmetric composition. Cover artwork. Composition: broad empty black sky at upper left and middle left, approximately left 55% of image until 65% height, for very large title. On the lower right, a convincing modular lunar research habitat with warm amber laboratory windows, a small amber six-wheeled helper robot in front, a dish on roof, craggy mountains behind. Lunar surface reaches bottom edge, strong foreground texture. Beside the habitat only, add two modest national flags with horizontal support rods in vacuum: Kazakhstan sky-blue with correct gold sun/eagle/hoist ornament, and USA stars and stripes, equal scale. Do not put flags near copy area. Earth tiny near upper right. Sophisticated environmental architecture visualization.
